```python
def autograd_l02_value_addition_node(id_a: str, val_a: float, id_b: str, val_b: float, out_id: str) -> dict:
    return {'id': out_id, 'val': round(float(val_a + val_b), 6), 'op': 'add', 'parents': [id_a, id_b]}
```
